title: vpc-deployment-health-broker-terraform-guardrails
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a small 'Health Broker' component and Terraform guardrail modules that consolidate VPC deployment SLO signals (latency p50/p95/p99, error-rate, token throughput saturation, and resource saturation) and expose pass/fail hooks for automated canary gating and upgrade-safe rollouts. Deliverables: a lightweight aggregator service (k8s) + Terraform data-sources/providers to evaluate health before promotion + synthetic load harness and runbook. Goal: prevent faulty private deployment upgrades from reaching production and provide a single source-of-truth for SLO decisions during upgrades.
acceptance_criteria: A Health Broker k8s deployment exists that ingests metrics from existing observability pipeline and evaluates configured SLOs in real-time
Terraform module provides a data source/boolean that commit CI and upgrade pipelines can query to gate promotions
Prebuilt policy templates for common rollouts: canary, linear-rollout, and instant-rollback when thresholds are breached
Synthetic token-replay load generator (token-replay) can run during canary and produce representative token throughput and latency profiles
Runbook with step-by-step incident procedures and exact thresholds is published and linked from Console rollout UI
comments: 2026-02-26 — Kickoff: scoped Health Broker to only use existing telemetry (prometheus metrics + tracing spans). Decided against adding new agent on edge workers to reduce upgrade blast radius. (Aisha)

2026-03-01 — Spike complete: prototype aggregator computes sliding-window token throughput and a saturation watermark per node type. Observed noise in p95 during bursty replays; added an adaptive smoothing window. (Marco)

2026-03-03 — Design review: PM (Lena Ortiz) requested explicit canary gating UX in Console and a Terraform data source for pipeline integration. Action: add provider shim and example pipeline job. (Design: deliver wireframes)

2026-03-05 — Eng review from SRE: agreed thresholds should be configurable per-customer; default policy will be conservative (p99 < 200ms, errors < 0.5%, sustained token-drop < 10% over 60s). Need security review for data-source credentials. (SRE: Rajiv Kumar)
2026-03-08 — PR opened: infra PR #1357 with k8s manifests and Helm chart for broker. Initial Electric CI tests failing due to RBAC policy; toggled to run under infra-service-account for now. (Marco)

2026-03-10 — Integrations: Terraform module prototype returns 'health_pass' boolean and a JSON blob of recent metric windows. PM asked to simplify to boolean for pipeline gating; will add 'explain' endpoint later. (Aisha)
2026-03-12 — Next: complete synthetic token-replay harness, add a 'dry-run' mode for the Terraform data source, and draft runbook. Security review scheduled 2026-03-18. (Marco)
Review notes: Design flagged need for telemetry cost guard (sample rates) when running synthetic replays at scale. Added label 'observability' and follow-up sub-issue planned.
implementation_notes: Health Broker will use existing Prometheus remote_read endpoints and compute per-namespace SLO windows. To avoid onboarding work, broker exposes a single HTTP endpoint /v1/evaluate?deployment=<id> returning pass/fail. Terraform module will call this via an external data source with retries and backoff. Synthetic token-replay will be implemented as a k8s Job with configurable qps and warmup profile. All config will be stored in a CRD so private deployments can tune thresholds independently.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: false positives during bursty traffic can block upgrades — Mitigation: adaptive smoothing window + minimum sample period before gating
Risk: synthetic replays could create noise for other customers — Mitigation: run replays in isolated canary namespace with rate-limits and quota checks
Risk: Terraform gating adds latency to CI — Mitigation: allow 'dry-run' fast-path and cached last-known-good value with TTL
